shadows.name: etched-brand
shadows.purpose: One-point etched highlight beneath the catalog wordmark.

shadows.name: button-depth
shadows.purpose: Ground the raised face; reduce the shadow for inset states.

shadows.name: lcd-glyph
shadows.purpose: Subtle depth beneath station dot-matrix lettering.

motion.name: button-press
motion.value: SwiftUI .easeOut(duration: 0.09); pressed label offset y: 1 pt, fixed socket
motion.purpose: Tactile press feedback; animation is nil when accessibilityReduceMotion is enabled.

native.platform: macOS 14+; SwiftUI in an AppKit popover
native.units: Native points; SF and SF Mono are SwiftUI system fonts.
native.previewPolicy: Native component descriptions only. No HTML/CSS replicas, web breakpoints, or web detector apply.
native.tonalRamps: No separate tonal ramps are implemented; the frontmatter preserves the actual palette without synthesized colors.

materials.silver: Tile Sources/SpinitronMenu/Resources/brushed-silver.png at opacity 0.85 over HiFi.paper; overlay a top-to-bottom gradient of white at 0.24 opacity, clear, and black at 0.06 opacity.
materials.raisedBezel: HiFi.edge strokeBorder width 1 pt; inner stroke inset 1 pt with white at 0.95 opacity to black at 0.14 opacity, topLeading to bottomTrailing.
materials.recessedBezel: Same geometry; inner gradient black at 0.28 opacity to white at 0.8 opacity.
materials.buttonSocket: Fixed rounded rectangle, radius 3 pt, SwiftUI sRGB (0.30, 0.36, 0.42); 1 pt top-to-bottom stroke from black at opacity 0.18 to white at opacity 0.9.
materials.buttonFace: Radius 2 pt; top-to-bottom gradient stops: white at 0, sRGB (0.91, 0.93, 0.95) at 0.42, (0.80, 0.83, 0.87) at 0.48, (0.89, 0.91, 0.94) at 1. Horizontal inset 1 pt, top inset 1 pt, bottom inset 3 pt. A 1 pt stroke runs from white to HiFi.edge at opacity 0.45.
materials.buttonInsetFace: Selected or pressed: HiFi.lcdTop at opacity 0.88 to HiFi.lcdBottom; horizontal inset 1 pt, top inset 2 pt, bottom inset 1 pt. A 1 pt stroke runs from HiFi.ink at opacity 0.4 to white at opacity 0.6.
materials.buttonSelection: 14 × 2 pt HiFi.blue capsule, bottom padding 4 pt; a 0.5 pt white highlight at opacity 0.7 across its top.
materials.buttonHover: Enabled hover: 1 pt HiFi.blue outline at opacity 0.75, radius 3 pt. If also not pressed, add white at opacity 0.15 over the face. Disabled opacity remains 0.48.
materials.lcdRim: Clip radius 4 pt; 1 pt outer stroke from HiFi.edge to white at opacity 0.95. Graphite sRGB (0.20, 0.27, 0.34) gasket: 2 pt stroke, radius 3 pt, inset 1 pt. Inner edge: 0.5 pt stroke, radius 1 pt, inset 3 pt, HiFi.ink at opacity 0.35 to white at opacity 0.65.
materials.lcdGlass: TopLeading-to-bottomTrailing reflection: white opacity 0.20 at 0, 0.05 at 0.45, clear at 0.46, white opacity 0.06 at 1. Edge shading inset 3 pt: 9 pt upper gradient from HiFi.ink opacity 0.42 to clear; 5 pt lower gradient from clear to white opacity 0.3. Overlays do not intercept pointer events.
materials.search: White at opacity 0.67; focus stroke HiFi.blue, 2 pt.
materials.rule: 1 pt HiFi.edge at opacity 0.30 above 1 pt white at opacity 0.65.

dotMatrix.lcdGrid: 0.5 × 0.5 pt cells every 3.4 pt; HiFi.blue at opacity 0.16
dotMatrix.inactiveCells: Station dot-matrix only: unlit glyph cells use HiFi.ink at opacity 0.08. The brand leaves inactive cells unpainted.
dotMatrix.fallback: Station strings longer than six characters or containing unsupported glyphs use the station-fallback typography token, one line, minimumScaleFactor 0.65.

buttonLcdPolish.verification: Release build and app signature passed; nine tests passed; native station selection and menu verified.

components.name: Hi-Fi button
components.description: Native HiFiButtonStyle with a fixed socket and raised metal face, minimum 30 × 30 pt. Compact horizontal padding is 8 pt. Press moves the label down 1 pt; enabled hover adds a blue outline. Disabled opacity remains 0.48 and press animation honors Reduce Motion.

components.name: Selected Hi-Fi button
components.description: Selected or pressed faces use the LCD gradient and deeper inset. A selected preset carries a 14 × 2 pt blue bar and retains the native selected accessibility trait.

components.name: Search
components.description: Plain native TextField in a translucent white recess, explicit blue focus stroke, secondary placeholder, and conditional clear button. Command-F focuses it.

components.name: Station LCD
components.description: Native Canvas dot-matrix lettering with inactive cells at 0.08 ink opacity, behind reflected glass with a graphite gasket and shaded inner edge. Ordinary-text accessibility labels and SF Mono fallback are retained.

components.name: Station presets
components.description: First two available stations use HiFiButtonStyle; a 24 × 30 pt native Menu with HiFiButtonSurface exposes all stations. Selected state is visible and accessible.

components.name: Playlist row
components.description: Full-width native button, minimum height 58 pt, two-line title, artist sample, fixed track count and outbound SF Symbol; hover uses playlist-row-hover.

components.name: Inset catalog
components.description: Recessed ScrollView with LazyVStack and pinned etched date headers; loading and empty states occupy the same region.

narrative.overview: Jordan selected this direction from the three-way Winamp concept board on October 6, 2026. Satin brushed silver, a blue dot-matrix LCD, tactile beveled controls, and compact navy text give the native catalog browser its identity. Preserve the chosen material and density when extending it.
keyCharacteristics: Satin silver chassis and shallow machined bevels.
Blue LCD and selected controls; navy text on pale playlist rows.
Native SF typography, custom dot-matrix lettering, and SF Symbols.
dos: Do reuse the HiFi palette, material, bezel, and button components.
Do preserve native keyboard, menu, focus, and accessibility behavior.
Do render real catalog records and let long titles increase row height.
donts: Don't replace the satin silver, blue LCD, or compact navy typography with a different visual world.
Don't rasterize catalog text or replace native controls with web controls.
Don't carry illustrative concept-board records or placeholder rows into the live catalog.
